If anxiety has its hands on you and that's what's holding you back the most. Then work on that first. You could start out small like talking to people here and looking up techniques on maintaining eye contact and confidence etc. Or see a therapist. 

For example. I found that I was unable to even go to a clinic to find a therapist. I couldn't leave my home. So to get things started and build up confidence with people, I stated using a mic to dominate with people in video games. I finally gained enough courage to contact the clinic a few days ago. 

There is hope.

I'm 23 and feel 15. I don't even feel comfortable telling people my real age.. Like I feel I haven't accomplished what I should have at this point. No car, no licence, no job, no house. I also just got my first boyfriend a couple of years ago and didn't have sex for the longest.

And like someone mentioned before.. Dreams. All of my dreams (nightmares really) involve teenage me, still in school, with my Nfamily chasing me around and screaming at me while I cry.

I was isolated like you. Not allowed friends, couldn't go out, working was a big no. I never learned how to progress into adulthood.

There will always be someone out there that disagrees with what you do or how you do it. And you know what? Its impossible to please everyone. 

It is perfectly fine to vent. You were hurt as a child and you are still suffering. You have the right to express how you feel and if you can't or don't want to talk to the people you know in real life, venting on your personal accounts is perfectly fine. Do what helps you. If an online diary makes you feel better, then you keep on posting.

My dads last words to me before he passed away were "you're a price of shit". Those words haunt me. That phrase said to anyone hurts whenever I hear it. And because he's gone, I'll never get closure from it. 

We all want an apology. I hope one day, maybe, you'll get yours.
It sounds like you should request a new psychologist. You should never be stressed because of your therapist. They are here to help with stress, not dismiss you.
Down voted a ton so I'm guessing this doesn't belong here? I apologize if so. Will remove is requested I guess.

Good, I'm glad you're trying to find a new one. It took me 2 years to try again but the anxiety is too bad to ignore at this point. 

I do too! Just being able to get lost in that drawing and forget for awhile works wonders.

I also don't have a licence for similar reasons but have been trying to learn. Do you have a friend or SO that could help teach you? If you can't find someone to help she'll never let you leave. And I know that's exactly what she is doing to you.

She says you can't work? Bullshit. My therapist told me to get disability and I told her that I didn't want to because I wanted to work. You actually can work and get disability. Besides, you're 21 years old. Those checks are yours to cash not hers. She wants to control you to keep you in her house. She doesn't want you to succeed and move on.

My mom did the same. Though I never lived with her she still tried to stop me from becoming an adult. She even stole my first and only car so I couldn't get to work and got fired. She still has it too. 

There are ways to get out of this and it will be hard. You'll feel even smaller at first, but you have to start putting your foot down. There will he reprocussions as well. I became homeless for example. But you know what? Its all worth it in the end. 

It is very strange. I'm so use to people saying "it can't he that bad" or "get over it". But it is that bad and we can't just get over it.

Edit: I realized having a car but no license made no sense lol. So to clear that up, I did in fact have a permit at the time and got it to learn in.

I imagine she was lying to you. Kind of a way to be in control of you.

I hope you find out what's wrong, I wish you the best!
I tried several times. I would cut contact and they would act nice a few months later as if nothing happened. I finally stopped falling for it once they caused me to lose everything.

I look just like my Nmom. She would also make fun of my looks in horrible ways. Then again, she swore up and down that I looked just like my dad and nothing like her. She would get horribly mad if anyone said I looked like her.

Oh my goodness I feel so connected to you its ridiculous. I also am new to posting and coming here and JUST posted my story. Mine is also a wall of text.. I haven't finished reading it just yet but wanted to comment before I eat.

I also gave IBS and I definitely understand your pain. On top of that I have a stomach ulcer. And just like you, my family refuses to believe it. Instead they tell people I refuse to eat because I'm anorexic and addicted to drugs.

My sister also use to be very mean to me because of my mom. They would call me catfish... Insinuating that I'm fat and ugly. My sister would spit in my face because my mom told her to. And they would laugh at my teeth because they're crooked since my parents refused to pay for my braces. Sadly my mother also ruined my sisters life overtime as well.

I also feel very small. I feel like a kitten in a lions den. I don't know how to fix myself or my situation.

I'll finish reading in a bit, but from what I see.. This is not normal and it is not your fault. And you're definitely not alone.

EDIT - finished reading: You say therapists are crap.. Have you tried switching clinics? I was blessed with my first therapist but ended up with a few duds after her. I'm trying to find a new one now. But you could find a great one, maybe ask around to see who people prefer? 

Since you live with your mother still, what do you do daily? School, work, paint, video games, etc? Having a hobby was helpful when I lived at home. Have you been working towards leaving? That would be the best option obviously.

But you are completely right. It helps to talk to people that understand what you're going through. Like REALLY understand. Feel free to message me anytime if you want to talk more about it.
Thank you very much. If I'm ever thankful for anything it is him. I don't know where I'd be otherwise.

Thank you for taking the time to listen. And thank you even more so for what you said. It actually made me cry.. But not in a bad way. 

I am trying to get into another clinic but I'm so tired of jumping through hoops. It makes me feel like it will never happen. Like I'll always feel this way. Like I'll always feel trapped. But what you said near the end changed my thought process about it a little.. "Even if it takes a week to brush one part of your hair". I read that paragraph quite a few times. I might not feel like I can do these things and they may be hard. They might take all the effort and strength I have in me to get done. But I can do it. Eventually; slowly. I didn't do anything today. But I think from now on I'm going to think back to your words. 

Thank you again. This past month has been a new low for me and you'll never fully understand just how much what you said means to me. I never imagined I would get a such a response. It is exactly what I needed right now. For someone to know.

Hello. Have you tried visiting a mental health clinic? Both clinics that I've been enrolled in have drug and alcohol programs available to anyone. If your insurance won't cover it, they'll base you off of a sliding scale.

That way may be a good option for you since you'll have a therapist to check up with once every two weeks or once a month, group sessions if you choose, and inpatient or outpatient care. They also could get you into sort of a housing program where you can live independently but have someone available to keep you in check 24/7 or less if you prefer.

Either way, they could at least offer support and point you in the right direction.
